caption: The drawing depicts a landscape scene of a river, with two sloping green hills in the foreground. On the left hill stands a tall tree with thin branches and autumn-colored leaves in shades of orange, yellow, and red, while on the right hill is another tall tree with green, leafy foliage. In the middle of the wide river, there is a small steamship with a paddle wheel, shown in dark colors, moving across the water, along with a few smaller indistinct boats in the distance. The river is colored in light blues and whites, reflecting the sky and the land. In the background, across the river, low blue-gray hills stretch horizontally, fading into lighter tones as they recede into the distance. The sky above is pale, with soft pink, orange, and blue hues blending together. The artwork is bordered in a rough rectangle, and just below the drawing, there is cursive writing that reads, "Detail sketch showing 'The Clermont on the Hudson River' painted on back-panel of chair," along with the signature "E. Josephine Steringer."
title: Clermont on Hudson Painting
